# radar-ng

> Self-hosted weather radar: an Expo phone app (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, CarPlay) and a web radar, backed by one Rust binary that downloads free public NOAA data, renders map tiles and serves them. Orchestrated by Temporal; runs with Docker Compose or Kubernetes. No API keys, no accounts.

radar-ng is a monorepo:
- `rust/`: Cargo workspace building one binary, `radar`: the HTTP API and tile server (`radar api`, axum), the Temporal workers (`radar worker --role …`: MRMS radar, HRRR forecast, NAQFC air quality, lightning, tropical, nowcast, Open-Meteo sync, alerts), the schedule seeder (Temporal Schedules, no cron) and `radar debug` diagnostics.
- `frontend/`: Expo SDK 58 / TypeScript app. Needs a native build (not Expo Go). App identity lives in `frontend/identity.js`.
- `web/`: the web radar (Vite + TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS), served from the same host as the API.
- `deploy/`: the Dockerfile (three image targets), the Docker Compose stack, and batteries-included Kubernetes manifests in `deploy/kubernetes/` (Kustomize base + optional components).

Images publish to `ghcr.io/<repo-owner>/radar-ng-{tile-server,temporal-worker,open-meteo-worker}` (upstream: `mitchross`).

## Run it
- [Docker Compose](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/self-host/compose.md): one computer, `deploy/up.sh`, prebuilt images.
- [Kubernetes manifests](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/deploy/kubernetes/README.md): `kubectl apply -k deploy/kubernetes/examples/minimal`, then make your own overlay.
- [Kubernetes background](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/self-host/kubernetes.md): storage, sizing, probes, schedules for production clusters.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/self-host/troubleshooting.md): gray map, no radar, ports, Temporal, arm64, disk.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/self-host/configuration.md): environment variables, including the `BASEMAP_PMTILES_URL` date gotcha.
- [Tuning](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/self-host/tuning.md): faster, cheaper or fresher, knob by knob.
- [Phone app](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/app/running-the-app.md): build, simulators, devices, IPA, CarPlay, Apple Watch.
- [Web radar](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/app/web-radar.md): run locally and host it (same-host routing).
- [Forking](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/FORKING.md): your own app IDs, server URL and images.

## Data sources
All free, public, no keys:
- NOAA MRMS: base reflectivity radar (`noaa-mrms-pds` on S3), ~2-minute cadence.
- NOAA HRRR: high-resolution forecast model (`noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds` on S3).
- NOAA NAQFC/AQMv7: air-quality guidance, bias-corrected PM2.5 + ozone (`noaa-nws-naqfc-pds` on S3), two cycles daily, 72 h horizon.
- NWS: active weather alerts (`api.weather.gov/alerts/active`).
- NHC: tropical cyclones (`nhc.noaa.gov/CurrentStorms.json`).
- Blitzortung: community lightning strike network.
- Open-Meteo: self-hosted forecast service (point/minutely/daily).
- Protomaps: vector basemap tiles (`build.protomaps.com`, date-stamped daily builds).

Licensing and terms for each: [third-party terms](https://github.com/mitchross/radar-ng/blob/master/docs/reference/third-party-terms.md).
